min_version_note: 0.10.0 is the release that will carry the transient RAOfflineProxy launch bridge: 0.10.0 is still in beta, and the bridge lands before it ships, so the floor names the first release that can actually route to this pak. Residual gap: the gate treats a pre-release as satisfying its own release floor (same rule as Syncthing), so a 0.10.0-beta.N older than the bridge also clears it -- acceptable because betas are dev builds and no catalog entry exists before 0.10.0 ships. min_jawaka_version is declared metadata, not a runtime gate: nothing on the device publishes an installed Jawaka version, and Jawaka ships inside the Leaf payload. Plan: umrk-workspace/plans/RAOfflineProxy/README.md.
